The plan card moved out of desk-look into a plugin of its own, desk-plan, so desk-look no longer answers Claude Code's permission dialog and can be listed in the Claude plugin directory.

- Plan approval in a card above the prompt now comes from the new `desk-plan` plugin in the same marketplace. It works as before: `1` approves, `2` opens the plan in desk-look's preview pane, type what to change to send it back, `9` for the engine dialog. desk-plan needs desk-look
- Without desk-plan, `ExitPlanMode` asks in Claude Code's own dialog. The `◇ Plan` card in the transcript stays in desk-look
- While the plan card is open it takes the band above the prompt alone; the repository chin no longer shows under it
- The plan card's notification moved to desk-plan's `notify` setting; desk-look's `askNotify` now covers the question card only
- `/desk-update` also updates desk-plan when it is installed

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-plan@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`, and install desk-plan if you used the plan card.
